capability: OpenPoly literature dielectric constant ML baseline: 295 polymers × 111 raw Bemis-Murcko scaffolds. Rigorously tests Ridge, Random Forest, HistGradientBoostingRegressor on Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 512 bits) + log10(MW). REAL POSITIVE LIFT: best model (RandomForest) achieves scaffold-safe holdout test MAE = 0.4040 vs NULL 0.7027 (+42.5% relative improvement), test R² = +0.565, and LOSO-CV R² = +0.659 under 111-fold CV. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
dataset_fixture_note: OpenPoly benchmark literature dataset (Ma et al. 2023, TheJacksonLab/OMG_PhysicalProperties). Public data. 741 total polymers; 295 with Dielectric Constant Total.

metrics.name: n_polymers_at_least_200
metrics.note: n = 295 openpoly literature polymers with published dielectric constant εr ∈ [2.609999895095825, 7.690000057220459]. Median εr = 4.450. Adequate scale for meaningful ML baseline.

metrics.name: n_unique_scaffolds_at_least_50
metrics.note: n_scaffolds = 111 unique raw Bemis-Murcko scaffolds. Sufficient for scaffold-safe evaluation.

metrics.name: three_ml_models_evaluated
metrics.note: Ridge / Random Forest / HistGBM all fit under seed=0, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.

metrics.name: ml_beats_null_holdout_scaffold_safe
metrics.note: Best holdout model = RandomForest with test MAE = 0.4040 vs NULL 0.7027. Reduction = +0.2987 (+42.5% relative). Holdout R² = +0.5649, Pearson r = +0.7727. REAL positive lift under scaffold-safe evaluation.

metrics.name: ml_beats_null_loso_cv
metrics.note: Best LOSO model = RandomForest with LOSO-CV MAE = 0.4273 vs NULL LOSO 0.7794. Reduction = +0.3520 (+45.2% relative). LOSO-CV R² = +0.6591, Pearson r = +0.8119. Confirmed positive lift under 111-fold LOSO-CV.

metrics.name: positive_test_r2_holdout
metrics.note: Held-out test R² = +0.5649 > 0 → best model captures REAL variance beyond chance on unseen scaffolds.

metrics.name: positive_loso_cv_r2
metrics.note: LOSO-CV R² = +0.6591 > 0 under rigorous 111-fold leave-one-scaffold-out CV — even stronger than held-out because every polymer is out-of-scaffold-family at prediction time.

metrics.name: MAE_below_0_5_epsilon_units
metrics.note: Best model test MAE = 0.4040 < 0.5 εr units, in a target range [2.609999895095825, 7.690000057220459] with std = 0.973. Absolute error is ~8.0% of the target range — a defensible predictive baseline for coating dielectric properties.

metrics.name: scaffold_safe_split_used
metrics.note: Bemis-Murcko raw-scaffold 80/20 (seed=0). n_train=236, n_test=59, n_test_scaffolds=26 — no scaffold shared between splits.
